focusStack.name: nf pi extension command: watch
focusStack.summary: Implement the "watch" command in the nf extension to monitor convergence of changes to the nf system of record as they are written to the file system.

focusStack.name: Integrate RGA64Stack with Git
focusStack.summary: Implement the integration logic to link RGA64Stack operations (push/pop) with Git observations using UUID64 and RGA64Watermark, ensuring that stack state changes are reflected in git-observable identifiers.

focusStack.name: Replace focusStack with RGA64Stack in world.ts
focusStack.summary: Refactor World class to use RGA64Stack instead of FormaList for the focus stack. This involves updating initialization, mutation methods (focusForma, unfocusForma), retrieval methods (focusedForma, focusOrder), and persistence logic (toJSON/fromJson).
